Topics for the 25th

No schedule. This is the running list of what we want to get through. Add anything you want on it, and tick things off as we cover them in the room.

Five directions

Five different worlds.

Each direction below is a real-world territory, not a mockup we made up. React to the actual brands and work, not a template with the colors swapped. Go fast. First instinct is the useful one, and thinking about it usually makes the answer worse. Nobody is choosing a final design here; this tells the identity designer which world feels closest.

Concept worth studying

Found on Behance, not a live brand

A design concept for a fictional Swiss private capital firm called VALTHERA — a portfolio case study, not an operating company, so this is here for craft, not as a sixth real-world territory. Worth studying: the oversized wordmark used as a section break, the rust/oxide accent against near-black and white (close to what we’ve already been circling), and real environmental photography instead of stock. Worth leaving behind: it’s cold and guarded throughout, which is the opposite of established without stuffy, local without small. See the full case study ↗

Live embed from Behance — needs a connection to load, and shows the whole case study (some of it site screens, some of it process and mobile mockups, not all of it the actual website).

How this works

Three things worth knowing.

Everything is live. Tick a box or type an answer and the others see it within a second. No sending, no saving, no attachments.
Nobody owns a section. If you have an opinion on something, add it even if someone already answered. Disagreement is useful.
Heidi can see it any time. So there's no need to tell her you've done something, and nothing here has a hard deadline beyond the timeline up top.
Connecting…
